summary: First iteration test run of WasteFlow MVP. Backend: 24/24 tests passed covering auth (all roles + 401), multi-tenant isolation (FCC vs SUMA vehicles/containers/routes disjoint), dashboard KPIs, live GPS simulation (positions change every ~5s), containers list+filter+detail history, routes list+detail (ordered by sequence)+optimize+reoptimize, driver flow (mine=true, complete OK, complete idempotent, geofence 409 with metros, fail auto-creates incident, ignore, DRIVER 403 on other driver's task), incidents (list/create/status transitions with resolved_at), analytics stats (totals/drivers ranking/waste_breakdown), and AI /api/ai/ask returning grounded Portuguese answer. Frontend: manager login lands on /painel with all 6 KPIs (8 camiões, 280 recolhas, 29 concluídas, 5 falhadas, 23 em atraso, 10 ocorrências) + schematic map + tabs Painel/Mapa/Rotas/Contentores/Mais; ROTAS tab shows GERAR ROTAS OTIMIZADAS button and route cards with distance/duration/capacity; CONTENTORES tab lists 140 with waste filter chips (Todos/Indiferenciados/Papel/Plástico...); Driver login (motorista@wasteflow.pt) shows A MINHA ROTA DE HOJE with R-101 summary, PRÓXIMA RECOLHA card #1 Rua de São Bento 159, and all four big buttons NAVEGAR/RECOLHIDO/PROBLEMA/IGNORAR with correct testIDs; Customer login shows PORTAL DO CLIENTE with OS MEUS CONTENTORES (7 own containers) and bottom tabs CONTENTORES/RECOLHAS/OCORRÊNCIAS. No red screens, no runtime errors, no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch deprecated packages detected.

ui_bugs.issue: The route-summary card values (26 RECOLHAS, 72.14 km DISTÂNCIA, 3h53 ESTIMADO) render nearly invisible in the driver dashboard — the values use color colors.onBrand (dark) on a colors.onSurface (dark) background inside the black summary block. Labels are visible; numbers are not. See /app/frontend/app/(driver)/rota.tsx:86-93 (styles.summary has backgroundColor: colors.onSurface; SumCell uses color={colors.onBrand}).

issues: Summary card text-on-dark contrast (see ui_bugs above). Consider color="#fff" or colors.surface for numeric values inside the black summary block.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated console warnings 'Failed to decode downloaded font SpaceGrotesk-Bold.ttf / -Medium.ttf — OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion: 168430090'. The web preview receives an HTML error page for /assets/?unstable_path=./assets/fonts/SpaceGrotesk-*.ttf instead of the .ttf binary, so the app falls back to system fonts on web. Reference: browser console logs; likely metro/web asset registry. Cosmetic only — text still renders.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a third-party component (react-native-web overlay). Non-blocking. Reference: browser console.

action_items: Fix contrast of numeric values inside the black route-summary card on the driver's rota screen (/app/frontend/app/(driver)/rota.tsx SumCell) — use a light color for the value on the dark background.
Investigate the SpaceGrotesk .ttf asset serving under Expo web (assets/?unstable_path=... returns HTML instead of the font). Font decode errors are noisy in the console. Cosmetic-only for now.
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_query correctly enforces company_id for every non-super_admin role — multi-tenant isolation tests confirm this.
Task complete endpoint is genuinely idempotent (returns the same task if already collected) and geofence returns HTTP 409 with 'metros' in the message as required.
fail_task auto-inserts a matching incident and notification atomically enough for the flow (verified by increased incident count).
GPS simulation loop is active, moves vehicles ~5s and positions are visible via /api/gps/live.
AI /api/ai/ask returns a Portuguese answer grounded in a real per-tenant context summary; error path returns a friendly Portuguese fallback.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 3 role flows load, all critical testIDs present; only 1 minor contrast bug)

seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing seed (FCC + SUMA + demo users). A few TEST_ incidents were created during API tests but did not corrupt any real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_wasteflow_api.py and can be re-run with `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v`. It relies on the exact seeded credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. If the driver has already finished all today's tasks, some driver-flow tests will pytest.skip — reseed with `cd /app/backend && python seed_data.py --force` to get pending tasks back. AI test depends on Emergent LLM key + emergentintegrations; if the LLM is down, the endpoint still returns 200 with a Portuguese fallback message, and the test only checks the answer string length + context summary keys.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no functional bug identified. Only one minor UI contrast issue on the driver route summary values (dark text on dark card).
